_readme: Test cases for the moderation policy.
The MUST-PASS cases matter more than the must-block ones. Over-blocking is the
failure that kills the site, and it is the failure nobody notices, because a
comment that never appeared generates no complaint.
The 'context' cases exist because an earlier blocking regex layer rejected five
of six of them. They are the reason the deterministic layer is now advisory only
and the model makes every decision. Keep them. Add more when you find them.
Run offline:  node scripts/check-moderation.mjs      (signal noise, informational)
Run with AI:  node scripts/check-moderation.mjs --ai (the real evaluation)
